portal_description:
The redhat-support-tool utility facilitates console-based access to Red Hat's subscriber services and gives Red Hat subscribers more venues for accessing the content and services available to them as Red Hat customers. The utility also enables Red Hat customers to integrate and automate their helpdesk services with our subscription services. 

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.7 Release Notes linked from the References section.

Users of redhat-support-tool are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
